negative_anchor.finding: Two independent FP chains regressed the exact-shape kernel by 1.36%, so FP dependency latency is not the limiting issue and reassociation is rejected.

hypothesis: The two CQ3 integer group decodes in each 256-weight block are independent, while their two scaled FMAs must remain ordered. Materializing both integer dot vectors and both scales before applying the original group-0 then group-1 FMAs may let the AVX2 scheduler overlap shift, mask, maddubs, and madd latency without changing a single FP32 reduction bit.

implementation.base: Pinned llama.cpp plus CQ3 v1 and the x86 pair test harness, without the rejected v11-v13 kernel changes
implementation.single_independent_change: Compute both independent integer group-dot vectors before the original two ordered FMAs.
unchanged: CQ8_0 activation values, sums, and scales
group-0 then group-1 FP32 FMA order

stop_rules: Stop before timing on any bit mismatch.
Reject before model integration if exact-shape speedup is below 5% or unstable.
Run exact-denominator quality gates only after performance passes.
Do not infer a score for an unrun gate.
claim_boundary: A pass would establish a bit-exact faster 2.125-bit CQ3 AVX2 primitive and justify selective 27B integration. It would not establish whole-model ternary speed, final-node throughput, energy gains, 100 accepted tok/s, novelty, or a breakthrough.
